name: what-carries
title: What Lets HAL-FORMS Carry the Release
kicker: Three things the parties do in HAL-FORMS
html:
What Lets HAL-FORMS Carry the Release

Named by relationscm:mergeEvery template is keyed by the act's relation, as a form is in HAL Schema Forms. One vocabulary for both dialects.
Lookups as link templatesscm:pulls-get/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pull_number}: a HAL-FORMS target can't hold variables; ARTIE fills the link template as a GET form.
Choices filled inlibrary:report-problemThe problem kinds live inside another resource; the server lists them in the template.

The watcher, the CI wrapper over Jenkins, the preview, Dev and the smoke script: unchanged.
say: Three things make HAL-FORMS carry the whole release. One: every template is named by its relation, the same names as in HAL Schema Forms, so one vocabulary serves both. Two: a HAL-FORMS target can't hold variables, so a lookup like get pull request comes as a link template, and ARTIE fills it like a GET form. Three: where an act's choices live inside another resource, like the library's problem kinds, the server fills them into the template, since HAL-FORMS can't point inside a document. The smoke script, the watcher, Jenkins, Dev: all unchanged.
